text:
Which statement about γ-radiation is correct?
A
It consists of very small charged particles.
B
It is a form of electromagnetic radiation.
It is less penetrating than β-radiation.
C
It is more highly ionising than α-radiation.
D

options.label: A
options.text: It consists of very small charged particles.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a form of electromagnetic radiation.

options.label: C
options.text: It is less penetrating than β-radiation.

options.label: D
options.text: It is more highly ionising than α-radiation.
